name: uams-web/uamswp-migration-api
description: Read-only migration API serving raw, current WordPress content to the Statamic importer.

scripts-descriptions.post-install-cmd: Wire core.hooksPath to .githooks so the CI-parity pre-commit hook is active in every clone.
scripts-descriptions.post-update-cmd: Wire core.hooksPath to .githooks so the CI-parity pre-commit hook is active in every clone.
scripts-descriptions.setup:integration: Install the Integration suite's own Composer setup in tests/Integration (Pest 3, PHPUnit 11, wp-phpunit, the polyfills). See #375.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit suite and the Integration suite, each in its own process from its own Composer setup. The Integration suite needs the test database: see README.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the Pest 5 suite that needs no WordPress and no database.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the suite that boots WordPress through wp-phpunit, from tests/Integration's own Composer setup.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration:secret: Re-run the shared-secret tests in a process where UAMSWP_MIGRATION_API_SECRET is defined. A constant cannot be undefined, so its two states need two processes.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration:single-site: Run the suite that boots WordPress again on a single-site install. MULTISITE is a constant fixed for the process, so each install shape needs its own process.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration:single-site:secret: Re-run the shared-secret tests on a single-site install, with UAMSWP_MIGRATION_API_SECRET defined.
scripts-descriptions.mutate: Mutate, from the Integration setup, the three classes mutation can actually reach and require the suite to kill each mutant. Needs a coverage driver; takes minutes. See docs/DECISIONS.md D-023.
scripts-descriptions.refactor:sweep: Apply every Rector rule, including judgment-call ones. Review the diff.
scripts-descriptions.ci: Run the full validation chain: PHPStan, Pint, Pest.
